train: Same prior-year Jan1 minus20day label cutoff; no evaluation labels used in fitting or thresholds
evaluation: Same918rows,2023-2026 reused development evaluation; not blind
methods: Baseline; natural classifier base/engineered; balanced classifier engineered. Mixture and hard routing separately.
routing: Class-specific training medians; neutral hard route uses separately trained median regressor. Mixture sums class median times uncalibrated classifier scores. Not a conditional median.
weights: Balanced class inverse frequencies from training only; no evaluation threshold tuning
interval: Each baseline interval width and offsets frozen, translate with centre only; diagnostic not newly calibrated interval
